classes.summary: HPXPrinterDetails is an Android UI page class that extends SmartFlow and provides comprehensive automation methods for interacting with HP printer details screen. It includes methods for navigating through various printer tiles (camera scan, print photos, scan, print documents, copy, mobile fax, shortcuts, printables, print quality tools), managing product information, printer settings, reports, device management, and scan operations. The class uses swipe gestures to locate elements and provides verification methods for UI elements with configurable timeout and exception handling.
